run_compute_structure_matches: run structure matching evaluation on all predicted crystal structures in a directory against experimental references
run_evaluate_structures_file: evaluate predicted crystal structures from a parquet file against experimental reference structures using CSD or pymatgen
run_load_target_structures: load experimental reference crystal structures from CIF files into a dictionary keyed by reference code
run_match_structures: compare a single predicted crystal structure against experimental references using CSD or pymatgen matching
run_ccdc_match_settings: configure CCDC PackingSimilarity settings for crystal structure comparison with custom shell size and tolerances
